records.label: Numeric equality does not establish identity
records.text: Equal numbers or matching labels in independent protocol, catalogue, implementation, and application namespaces do not establish identity or a join.

records.label: Identity is not address
records.text: An installed Device ID, diagnostic WHERE, and functional WHERE have distinct roles; none may be substituted for another merely because observed values resemble each other.

records.label: slot is not Module or address
records.text: A slot is the numeric position that locates a Module; it is neither the Module itself nor the Module's configured functional address.

records.label: Capability is not runtime state
records.text: Catalogue capability describes what a Device or firmware can support; diagnostic and functional observations describe installed or runtime state and must not be silently substituted for capability.

records.label: WHERE is system-specific
records.text: Resolve the interface variant and WHO before interpreting WHERE; no single universal address grammar applies to every OpenWebNet system.

records.label: Configuration requires resolved context
records.text: A configuration index or value is meaningful only in its resolved Device, firmware, Module, Object, ownership, and operation context.

records.label: Public specification and implementation can differ
records.text: Differences between published protocol documents and versioned implementation artifacts must remain explicit source or version differences, not be silently reconciled.

records.label: Source counts are not protocol limits
records.text: Counts measured in a particular database revision describe that source revision and are not universal protocol maxima or complete product-family counts.

records.label: ZigBee source publication provenance is unresolved
records.text: The supplied ZigBee OpenWebNet specification carries Confidential footers; its public-release provenance remains unresolved even though its interface semantics are used as qualified specification evidence.

OWN-DEV-0019: evidence and applicability boundaries
records.text: OWN-DEV-0019: Six capacitive zones are six command Modules plus a seventh UI Module. Preserve M3/M4 and BTicino/Arteor electrical scope, M6 cyclic-heading/noncyclic-prose discrepancy, physical I table without corresponding socket and stored SET rather than SPE. Scenario banks, calibration/cleaning/erasure timers and production-specific Classe300EOS restrictions remain distinct; Virgin-only candidates do not prove runtime selection. Catalogue associations and defaults do not establish installed state or every candidate capability. Obtain a sanitized fingerprint showing all six button slots plus UI slot `7`. Correlate `DIMENSION 30` Virgin-Object identifiers with software-selected roles on real hardware. Locate direct official documentation for `574091` and `574591`. Determine whether the empty condition `4145` rows have any runtime significance. Correlate wildcard catalogue applicability with observed firmware versions.

records.text: OWN-DEV-0020: Four buttons/LEDs and four logical Modules visualize and force load priorities; they are not four power relays. Conversion references 421/431/441/451 have no EN_CONV_RULE rows; documented product arithmetic does not fabricate their implementation. Catalogue associations and defaults do not establish installed state or every candidate capability. Obtain a sanitized four-slot `DIMENSION 30` / `DIMENSION 35` fingerprint from a known panel. Recover or independently establish the missing conversion logic referenced as `421` / `431` / `441` / `451`. Reconcile the documented decimal `P1` / `P2` priority composition with the missing catalogue conversion-rule records before implementing a database-driven converter. Correlate wildcard firmware applicability with observed firmware versions. Check whether phase configuration is surfaced consistently across all six commercial identities.

records.text: OWN-DEV-0055: Dual PIR/US wall product retains Spanish versus MM-c threshold, Auto factory state, remote-route and coverage conflicts plus GermanIP44/12mA versus exactIP42/17mA. Headline77m2 PIR label conflicts with detailed39PIR/77US matrix; Spanish30s sensitivity unit is unresolved. FirmwareA/PL0..9 andS0..4 versusphysical1..9/0..3 remain distinct; IR slots and shared restrictions are not hardware proof. Catalogue associations and defaults do not establish installed state or every candidate capability. Coverage, threshold and configuration-route conflicts remain unresolved by a change log or hardware revision. Exact Legrand-reference physical specifications and independent EAN records are not retained; its identity is established by the catalogue. Virtual Configurator/glossary, 3503N/web-server procedures, remote manuals and Plug&Go/Project&Download guides referenced by the sheets are not independently examined here. For OWN-DEV-0061, Object configuration surfaces / Device-specific interpretation has this documented qualification: Slot `1` admits six sensor Objects (119/128/164/165/166/168); slots `2..17` designate IR scenario Object `431`. Virgin `515` applies only to slot `1` and admits the same six alternatives. These are software placements, not seventeen physical sensors. Reusable timers default to 10 minutes in 119/168 and 15 minutes in 128/165; these do not override a product factory setting. `DAYLIGHT_SETPOINT` and `PROVISION_OF_LIGHT` encode `1..255` as five times the stored value in lux: setpoint default 100 means 500 lux, with zero unlabelled; provision zero means Automatic. Object `431` `TYPE_OF_REGULATION` is restricted to 3 (stereo), excluding default 1 without a replacement; this does not prove sixteen installed IR functions or speaker hardware. Firmware `135` stores M predicates selecting 128 for `M=2`, 166 for `M=1/4` and 168 for `M=0/3`; alternatives 119/164/165 lack a stored M selection. Firmware A/`PL=0..9` default 0 and `S=0..4` differ from physical A/`PL=1..9` and `S=0..3`. No conversion is associated. Occupancy restrictions retain `US`-only and combined `PIR`/`US` choices on this `PIR`-only product; they are software evidence, not ultrasonic construction. `ALERT` subsets exclude default 0; `DAYLIGHT_SETPOINT` and `PROVISION_OF_LIGHT` on 168 have subset flags with no allowed values. These remain unresolved restrictions, not unrestricted fields. This is reusable catalogue configuration, subject to Device-specific placement and filters; it does not establish physical support or installed state.
